label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Oyeron pueblos, tiemblan; temblor agarró a moradores de Peléshet.
spanish: Oyeron pueblos, tiemblan; estremecimiento agarró a los moradores de Peléshet.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'temblor' with 'estremecimiento' per the audit warn: in Latin American Spanish 'temblor' reads as an earthquake, while חִיל licenses the shuddering/anguish that seizes the inhabitants; same singular masculine noun class, same agreement with 'agarró', no participant or sense change.
Added the definite article 'los' before 'moradores' as Spanish grammar requires with the personal 'a' before a specific plural object; no participant or number change.
